title: Life Link one-line invitation payload v1
description: The compact JSON payload encoded as unpadded base64url after the LR1. prefix. This object contains a short-lived secret.

central_base_url.description: Absolute HTTPS base URL. Query strings and fragments are forbidden.

invitation_token.description: A high-entropy, short-lived, single-use bearer secret.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry. Invitation creation defaults to 24 hours from issuance.
